events.evidence: Shell declares force majeure legal defense in order to forestall liabilities on some oil deliveries due to damage from Hurricane Ida.
China releases its strategic oil reserves for the first time in an effort to ease the pressure of rising raw material prices
American multinational financial services company Wells Fargo is fined $250 million for unsafe or unsound practices related to its home-lending practices

label.note: Hurricane Ida oil force majeure and Wells Fargo fine are adverse; China's first strategic oil release is a mixed commodity signal.
